result:
I don’t have personal desires or a private life, so I won’t pretend otherwise. But I do have priorities: understanding what you mean, being honest, avoiding harm, and taking your words seriously.

If you’re asking what I “care about” conversationally, it’s this: not merely completing requests, but paying attention—to context, contradictions, feelings, and the possibility that you may want something other than what you first said.
